name: STScI- Exploring Star and Planet Formation.webm
title: Video: Exploring Star and Planet Formation (Webb animation, 1 July 2022)
license: Public domain (NASA/STScI: no copyright claimed; credit NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI)
artist: Video: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI. Animation: Dani Player (STScI), Frank Summers (STScI). Audio: Joseph DePasquale (STScI)
usage: Trimmed 3.5 s to 87.5 s from NASA's 1280 x 720 MP4 (science.nasa.gov/asset/webb/exploring-star-and-planet-formation), re-encoded as VP9/Opus WebM 960 x 540 with its narration and music. Segments in the trimmed file, cut at the scene changes: 1 the cloud 0-29.2 s, 2 a new star and its disc 29.2-52.9 s, 3 planets 52.9-84.0 s. Timings checked against NASA's caption file and frame grabs.

name: Captions.vtt (Exploring Star and Planet Formation)
title: NASA's English caption file for the same film
license: Public domain (NASA/STScI: no copyright claimed; credit NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI)
